title: Signal: R package DESCRIPTION declares no licence
scope: A DESCRIPTION file that declares a DESCRIPTION that records no licence.
limitations: It matches a DESCRIPTION that records no licence in the parsed DESCRIPTION; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A DESCRIPTION that mentions a DESCRIPTION that records no licence in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
